description: This file defines the Cloud9Client class for interacting with AWS Cloud9 service, including method annotations for various Cloud9 operations.

classes.name: Cloud9Client
classes.description: Client class used for interacting with the AWS Cloud9 service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: createEnvironmentEC2
methods.description: Creates an EC2 environment in AWS Cloud9.

methods.name: describeEnvironmentStatus
methods.description: Provides status information for a specified environment.

methods.name: listEnvironments
methods.description: Lists all environments in your account.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource with specified tags.
